statement: Let M be a finite type II1 von Neumann algebra with separable predual and faithful normal tracial state τ. There exist a symmetric, countably supported probability measure μ on U(M) and a strictly increasing sequence nℓ → ∞ with the following properties. The positive-mass atoms of μ contain a countable 2-norm dense subset of U(M), and hence generate M as a von Neumann algebra. For every r ∈ N, every nonempty finite set W ⊂ Fr \ {e}, and every η > 0, if G (ℓ) 1 , . . . , G (ℓ) r are independent with law μ∗nℓ , then Pr ( max w∈W ⏐ ⏐ ⏐τ ( w(G (ℓ) 1 , . . . , G(ℓ) r ) )⏐ ⏐ ⏐ ≥ η ) −→ 0. Thus these products have joint free Haar moments in probability.
